comparison_notes: All four arms have 8451 trainable parameters and identical initial projection/readout/gate tensors within each seed; raw gates start at zero without RNG draws. Minibatches are paired.
Anchored features use (1-g)*f + g*phi(1,0,0); gated-context features use (1-g)*f + g*causal(f), with g=tanh(raw_mix). The anchor is fixed, not learned.

Primary contrast is anchored elliptic minus anchored tangent. Also report geometry within gated context, anchor minus context within each map, and their paired interaction, including every losing seed.
Rust owns both nonlinear maps and complete VJPs; ordinary controls use its fixed anchor/Jacobian with explicit Torch blend/attention. This is not matched computation or a speed test.
All twelve runs are retrained from identity, not initialized from earlier endpoints or the frozen-weight ablation. Endpoints are locked until all runs and continuation checks complete.
Pride and Alice were already inspected and motivated the anchor design. These are reused exploratory sets, not untouched confirmation or evidence of general LLM advantage.

A fixed-anchor adapter is pointwise, but the underlying GPT-2 hidden state is contextual. Some gate scaling can be absorbed into the readout; optimization effects are not necessarily added expressivity.
Gated controls are rerun with the current frozen package. Exact historical replays, if observed, are reproducibility evidence and not independent replications.
Full unpadded contexts, model KV cache disabled, CPU float32. No hyperparameter selection from interim development loss, resident WGPU claim, or acceleration claim.
